name: Job Shop Scheduling Benchmark
description: We introduce an open-source GitHub repository containing comprehensive benchmarks for a wide range of machine scheduling problems, including Job Shop Scheduling (JSP), Flow Shop Scheduling (FSP), Flexible Job Shop Scheduling (FJSP), FJSP with Assembly constraints (FAJSP), FJSP with Sequence-Dependent Setup Times (FJSP-SDST), and the online FJSP (with online job arrivals). Our primary goal is to provide a centralized hub for researchers, practitioners, and enthusiasts interested in tackling machine scheduling challenges.
reputation: Open-source repository used by the scheduling and operations-research community; adoption is growing though there is no single unified leaderboard across all variants.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; instance heterogeneity (JSP, FJSP, FSP, etc.) and NP-hardness mean results vary greatly with instance size, solver choices, and hardware; direct comparisons require careful protocol alignment.
